name: isdt-kairos-club
description: ISDT Kairos Club monorepo root. backend/ and frontend/ deploy as separate services (Render API + static web), and the API also serves frontend/dist when it is built (`npm install` at the root builds both), giving a zero-config single-service deployment.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run db:generate && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
